kind: portable six-actor discrete coat fixture and check contract; not an executable order

coatContract.seedBasis: actual saved CWLS namespace plus CWLA per-reference identity; coatSeed version1
coatContract.choiceBasis: retain eligible saved pool/pattern; otherwise maximum coatScore over eligible IDs

surfaceObservations.source: CLAW bounded read-only actual-surface audit, separate from requested/applied pattern diagnostics
surfaceObservations.shortStringTransport: Read the one bounded chunk array, join all ordered ASCII elements without separators, then parse the complete JSON. Empty means unavailable; never parse individual chunks or mix getter calls.
surfaceObservations.modelGenerationMeaning: Retained third-person root identity only. An unchanged token does not certify unchanged biped parts, children or geometry; compare the full observed inventory independently.
surfaceObservations.onEmptyStaleOrIncomplete: Unavailable; never substitute desired catalog paths, a prior sample or cached appearance status.
surfaceObservations.duplicateNames: Compare the full observed multiset. Do not select the first matching name or infer unchanged inventory across a model-generation change.
surfaceObservations.scope: Third-person loaded beast graphs and exposed material fields only; no pixels, opaque renderer state, human-return renderer readback or arbitrary later-writer ownership proof.

phases.name: source-baseline
required: six exact same-run identities
both human actual keyed source vectors and weights
actual human source colour availability
four initially-beast actors without invented human hair
before-mutation morph observations and fresh actual-surface samples on loaded beasts

phases.name: automatic-selection
required: 34 manual catalogue IDs
two human transforms with advancing frames
eligible measured hair pool for each observed human source
saved-reference natural fallback on four born wolves
two stable requested/applied/origin/status samples

phases.name: manual-isolation
required: one explicit Black male and Timber female
manual origin and completed private application
fresh observed managed diffuse-set and bound-resource paths match the selected complete pattern
complete excluded-surface observations remain unchanged within the same model generation
same-base neighbours retain their IDs and morph values
invalid ID rejected before queue without any changed actor
clear resumes the previous eligible automatic choice
retain manual and automatic cases together before save

phases.name: refresh-persistence
required: refresh all six once
stable pattern/origin and unchanged source/key maps
one disposable six-reference ESS/SKSE save pair
one same-process owned load and six-reference remap
same saved namespace/identities/seeds/pools/manual IDs
independent saved-byte selection verification

phases.name: post-load-manual-clear
required: clear exactly one restored manual override after owned load/remap
completed requested/applied/origin reads return its retained eligible automatic choice
fresh actual-surface sample agrees with that automatic pattern
all other remapped actors retain their choices and source/key values

phases.name: human-return-retransform
required: return only the two controls to their witnessed human races
no applied wolf coat on humans
human source/key preservation and own-key absence
transform both controls again
same eligible saved automatic/manual selection after refresh

phases.name: technical-evidence-and-finish
required: fresh actual-surface readback with actor identity and request/sample timing witnesses
guarded menu finish and actual process outcome
native and external restoration to the exact current attempt baseline
separate mechanical/material-observation/shutdown findings

noClaims: independent shader RGB from cached status
